{
  "correction_rules": [
    "When sentiment is negative (≤ 0), reduce forecasted prices by 5-10% to account for downward pressure.",
    "If recent history shows a sharp spike followed by a drop, apply a 10-15% downward correction in the next 3-5 days.",
    "For long-term forecasts (30-day), if the model consistently overestimates prices after a dip, apply a 5-8% downward bias correction.",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.5), increase forecasted prices by 3-7% to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "If the model’s 30-day forecast is significantly above the 15-day moving average, apply a mean reversion correction by reducing the forecast by 5-10%.",
    "For forecasts with high volatility (e.g., > 10% deviation from true outcome), apply a smoothing filter to reduce overshoots.",
    "If sentiment history shows a recent upward trend (e.g., 3+ consecutive positive sentiment), adjust forecast to reflect a 2-5% upward bias for the next 5 days."
  ]
}
